description: Adoption audit found .env GPG_SIGNING_KEY_ID=25C253158685D428 (init-project.sh candidate) while git config user.signingkey is 266E6A4865C6C51D with commit.gpgsign=true, so commits are signed by a key other than the candidate. Operator should choose the project attestation signer via the signer proposal ADR in DECISIONS.md and record it in project.manifest.yaml prompt_provenance.attestation, making .env agree. Surfaced by brownfield-adoption-agent-v1.0.
